g.text: 1. ALL EQUIPMENT AND PIPING IN SOUR GAS SERVICE SHALL CONFORM TO NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156. MATERIAL CLASS A1A APPLIES THROUGHOUT.
2. PSV-1001 SET PRESSURE 95 BARG. PSV SIZING PER API 520. OUTLET LINE TO SOUR FLARE HEADER. NV-1001 AND NV-1002 (PSV BLOCK VALVES) SHALL BE LOCKED OPEN
3. BDV-1001 SHALL BE NORMALLY CLOSED. OPENS AUTOMATICALLY ON ESD-1 SIGNAL FROM SIS. MANUAL OPEN CAPABILITY FROM CCR ONLY. BLOWDOWN RATE PER API 521
4. XV-1001 AND XV-1002 ARE ESD CLASS VALVES. PARTIAL STROKE TESTING (PST) CAPABILITY REQUIRED. PROOF TEST INTERVAL PER SIL ASSESSMENT.
5. PIG RECEIVER PG-1001 QUICK-OPENING CLOSURE SHALL BE INTERLOCKED - CLOSURE CANNOT BE OPENED UNLESS INLET PRESSURE IS CONFIRMED ZERO ON PI-1001 AND
XV-1001 IS CONFIRMED CLOSED. INTERLOCK LOGIC IN SIS.
6. ALL INSTRUMENT CONNECTIONS ON SOUR SERVICE LINES SHALL HAVE DOUBLE BLOCK AND BLEED VALVE ARRANGEMENT ON THE INSTRUMENT ROOT VALVE.
7. DRAIN LINE 2"-DR-00101-A1A ROUTES TO CLOSED DRAIN DRUM. NO OPEN DRAINING PERMITTED ON SOUR SERVICE.
